about: brief 089 name check (tools/names/check.ts). allow: a name Sky pinned that is on the ban list (none today). alsoWords: names on the list that are also English words, counted only when capitalised. ignore: a string the check reads that is never on screen, by source, path prefix and the whole string. expected: the failing hits (strong, reported) known when the check landed; each fails once gone, all fail after until. Lookalikes are warnings and never listed here.
